This case involving Rigathi Gachagua shows a situation where, no matter the court decision, he will still come out politically stronger in one way or another.
If he wins the case, he becomes more strong legally and gains more authority. If he loses, he may still gain public sympathy and keep strong support from his followers, especially in mt Kenya.
For William Ruto, this means the political situation becomes more complicated. The main challenge is not the court ruling itself, but how people react after it—how alliances shift and how public opinion changes.
In simple terms, Gachagua remains politically strong in both situations, while the presidency has to carefully manage a more unpredictable political environment....
